title: Law to require yearly report on voucher homeownership program
summary: This bill would require the Department of Housing Preservation and Development to publish an annual report on the Housing Choice Voucher Homeownership Program, covering participation, eligibility and successful home purchases broken down by borough, income level, household type and race. It would also direct HPD to request matching data from New York State Homes and Community Renewal. The first report would be due within one year of the law taking effect.
